Overview
Design approach & what’s in this batch
Read me first
Shift@PennHousing · Worker app
iOS (light + dark) · Android Material 3 · native HIG / Material You · for Andrew @ Harnwell
APPROACHMinimal, calm, Linear/Things-grade restraint. One Shift Blue against cool near-black & off-white; semantic state colors carry meaning and always pair with an icon + text tag.
BUILT① Calendar · ①b House schedule · ② Pick-shift · ③ My Shifts · ④ Open + Claim · ⑤ Float Ack · ⑥ Updates / Login / Settings — with filled + key empty/loading/error states.
THEMING⑦ Dark mode is a single .theme-dark token scope — every iOS screen is dark-capable for free, not a fork. Foundations + the hero screens shown.
ANDROID⑧ The same app, native to Android — like Netflix or Duolingo: identical IBM Plex type, white/tinted cards, the same colors & state legend. Only the chrome changes (frame, status bar, Material bottom nav); bottom sheets go edge-to-edge.
INTERACTIVECalendar views + week picker · Open cards → trim a portion + live hours-cap math · My Shifts drop → Dropped → Reclaim · Float Acknowledge → success — on both platforms.

Worker state legend
Worker state legend
Load-bearing — shared with the web product. Always color + icon + text tag, never color alone.
Normal scheduled
Default surface. Your home desk.
Float-out
Sent to another desk. Purple + destination.
Pending float
Floated, not yet acknowledged. Amber “Pending”.
Picked-up (home)
You claimed an open shift. 8px pickup dot.
Cross-house pickup
Picked up at another house. Purple + dot.
Float-in
You’re covering this desk. Green.
Break shift
Break-period shift. Golden left border.
Open — claimable
One-time gap. Dashed outline + Claim.
Permanent opening
Recurring slot dropped by owner. Magenta.
Unpickable (T-2h)
Past the cutoff. Muted, no action.
Dropped — still open
You dropped it. One-tap Reclaim.
Allied-covered
Covered by allied staff. Teal.
Acknowledged
Float ack confirmed. Green success.

Same app, native to the platform — like Netflix or Duolingo. Identical IBM Plex type, white/tinted cards with colored text, the same colors and the same load-bearing state legend as iOS.
